newsitem.title: USA: Fluor initiates share repurchase program.
newsitem.headline: Fluor initiates share repurchase program.

text.p: Fluor Corp on Thursday said it has initiated a previously authorized stock buyback program to repurchase up to 5.0 million shares of common stock in the open market or through private deals.

The move comes in the wake of a 13 point drop in the price of Fluor's shares in Wednesday trading after the company reported a fiscal first quarter profit of $0.73 a share versus a profit of $0.68 a share one year ago. Analysts had expected Fluor to earn $0.78 a share, according to First Call.
Fluor shares rebounded on Thursday, closing up 2-1/2 at 64-3/8.
In a statement, Chairman Les McCraw said he was surprised by the stock market's reaction.

McCraw noted Fluor's earnings were up eight percent over the prior year with a slighly higher operating profit at construction unit Fluor Daniel and 20 percent growth at its coal operation, A.T. Massey.
